messages.author: 82933c06b1097cc4
messages.subject: LOD score decreased after running refineqtl
parts:
I have used fitqtl to select a model, then used the final model to calculated the final qtl. Then I used refineqtl to refine the position of the qtl, the final model contains two qtl and their interactions, both location of qtl moved some distances after the refineqtl step. Surprisingly, the overall LOD score decreased from 9.86 to 8.25, and one QTL and their interaction decreased from ** to *, should I trust the refine qtl results or stick to the old results. And why I did I get such result?
Thank you

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] LOD score decreased after running refineqtl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] LOD score decreased after running refineqtl
parts:
The problem that Gill had reported turned out to be due to many tightly linked markers with discrepant genotype information, and re-constructing the qtl object with imprecise QTL positions.

refineqtl should not be decreasing in LOD. If you have found a case where it does, please send me data and code that I can use to reproduce and then fix the problem.

thanks,
karl
